card.line: Gennesaret was a fertile area on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, where Jesus landed, healed many sick people, and taught crowds by the lake.

moments.title: Jesus teaches from the boat
moments.text: Crowds pressed in on Jesus by the Lake of Gennesaret to hear God's word. He sat in Simon's boat and taught the people from it.

moments.title: A catch of fish
moments.text: Jesus told Simon to let down his nets in deep water. Simon obeyed, and they caught so many fish that the nets began to tear and both boats began to sink.

moments.title: The sick are healed
moments.text: Jesus and His disciples landed at Gennesaret, and the people recognized Him. They brought all their sick, and everyone who touched the fringe of His cloak was healed.
